name: Fallen / Brand New World
source:
A "cohabitation life simulation" where you live under the same roof as the heroine and interact freely. Lily serves as your maid and spends day and night with you. Manage a tavern together, deepen your bond, and enjoy life in the city.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01348926.html/]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
这是一款“同居生活模拟”游戏，玩家将与女主角生活在同一个屋檐下，自由互动。莉莉是你的女仆，与你朝夕相处。两人可以一起经营酒馆，加深感情，享受城里的生活。

［摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01348926.html/]DLsite[/url]］
